release.recordType: verified production Bring Your AI connection release

git.markerMeaning: The v0.6.0 private-first product merge is the prior release marker. Every first-parent merge after it through the currently deployed production commit is classified here.

productionDeployment.evidence: Vercel deployment API reports meta.githubCommitSha 7a1081dd937f43d9ef8b97586e89633b8334611c on ref main, aliased to movingmanifest.com and assistwithmoving.com. The deployed SHA equals origin/main HEAD exactly, so production serves this ledger's `to` commit with nothing merged behind it.

productionAcceptance.discovery: npm run mcp:doctor and npm run mcp:doctor:legacy each returned 10 pass / 0 warn / 0 blocked / 0 fail against production on 2026-08-17, covering the anonymous 401 challenge, the resource_metadata pointer, the Clerk authorization server, registration/authorize/token endpoints, PKCE S256, and the advertised identity scopes.
productionAcceptance.grantContract: GET https://movingmanifest.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp served scopes_supported [openid, profile, email], client_id_metadata_document_supported true, dynamic_client_registration_fallback_supported true, and the x-assistwithmoving block carrying grantBoundaryVersion 2026-08-16, productGrantRequired true, the five moving.* product scopes, the grant-manager URL, and the four-door map.
productionAcceptance.doorSeparation: POST https://movingmanifest.com/api/mcp without credentials returned 401 with a WWW-Authenticate challenge naming the API-key door and redirecting OAuth clients to https://movingmanifest.com/mcp. Its protected-resource document correctly advertises no authorization server, so the API-key door cannot be mistaken for the OAuth door.
productionAcceptance.cleanup: No production fixture, move, Queue row, MCP record, OAuth client, grant, token, password, session, or device was created in this release proof. Every probe was an unauthenticated read.
notProved: a named AI product completing the full connect-to-revoke lifecycle against production
a production consent screen, five-scope grant approval, or token exchange
production Queue claim/ask/complete under a canonical OAuth grant
production private-photo byte delivery under the new media budgets
productionAcceptance.whyNotProved: The real-client lifecycle needs a production Clerk identity and a production Clerk secret. The repository checkout holds only development Clerk credentials (a pk_test_/sk_test_ pair for glorious-swine-50.clerk.accounts.dev) and a development Convex deployment, so no production person-step can be driven programmatically from it. Creating a production account, or obtaining a production Clerk secret, is an outside-the-repository decision reserved to Scott under MOV-WO-010's stop rules.

sources.reason: Adds two optional compatibility fields to the moves table so documents left by an abandoned branch still validate. Schema-level deploy unblock with no behaviour a person or an AI can observe.
